description: This PHP source file defines the class Openads_Links, which provides methods to read and write .links.ini configuration files related to database table links in the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: Openads_Links
classes.description: A class to handle reading and writing of .links.ini files for database table link configurations.

methods.name: readLinksDotIni
methods.description: Reads and parses a .links.ini file, returning an array of linked tables and fields.

methods.name: writeLinksDotIni
methods.description: Writes a given array of links to a .links.ini file.
